import pathlib
import runpy
import sqlite3

root = pathlib.Path('.')
old = runpy.run_path('old_reader.py')['QUERY']
new = runpy.run_path('new_reader.py')['QUERY']
db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
db.executescript((root / '001_initial.sql').read_text())
db.execute('INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', (1, 'Existing user'))

def check(stage, query, expected):
    try:
        rows = db.execute(query).fetchall()
        outcome = 'ok'
        detail = repr(rows)
    except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
        outcome = 'error'
        detail = str(exc)
    assert outcome == expected, (stage, outcome, expected)
    print(f'{stage}: {outcome}: {detail}')

print('SQLite version:', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
check('Initial schema / old reader', old, 'ok')
check('Initial schema / new reader', new, 'error')
db.executescript((root / '002_up.sql').read_text())
check('Migration applied / old reader still serving', old, 'error')
check('Migration applied / new reader', new, 'ok')
db.execute('INSERT INTO users (id, display_name) VALUES (?, ?)', (2, 'Created after migration'))
check('Rollback old binary before down migration', old, 'error')
db.executescript((root / '002_down.sql').read_text())
check('Down migration / old reader', old, 'ok')
check('Down migration / remaining new reader', new, 'error')
assert db.execute(old).fetchall() == [(1, 'Existing user'), (2, 'Created after migration')]
print('Up/down round trip preserves both sample rows.')
print('All compatibility expectations verified; no deployment executed.')
PY"
